name: ui/address-selector
title: AddressSelector
summary: "Deliver to": a radio group of the user's saved addresses in a fieldset with a legend. Each option is a whole-row label with the name, a line and the Kweli code; private addresses say so in words.

props.name: addresses
props.description: { id, label, line?, code?, visibility? } per saved address.

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the chosen address.

props.name: addHref
props.description: Where "Add an address" goes. No link without it.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: A real radio group: one <input type="radio"> per address with the same name, inside a <fieldset> with a <legend>, so it works and submits with no script.
Each option is a whole-row <label> at least 56px tall.
The chosen option is checked and outlined in --primary, so the choice is never colour alone.
A private or link-only address is marked "Private" or "Link only" in words; a public one is not marked.
With no addresses the group says "No saved addresses yet." and shows only the add link.

keyboard: Tab into the group; arrow keys move between addresses; Space selects.
focus: The --ring focus ring on the row whose radio has focus.
aria: The legend names the group; each radio is named by its whole row; privacy is written out.

theming.brandOverlay: Only --primary (the chosen outline, the radio's accent, the add link) and --ring change with the brand.

noJs.without: Everything: native radios in a form.

responsive: Rows fill the container; the name and line truncate before the code is squeezed.
contract:
contract
  slot is "address-selector"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/address-selector"
  when default shows legend "Deliver to"
  label "Home" min_height 56
  when empty shows p "No saved addresses yet."
  when named shows legend "Pick up from"
end

checks.say: One radio per address, same name.
Codes are in the mono face.
The field name is the caller's.
